facts.fact: On 17 June 2026 the Secretariat permanent de l'innovation et de la veille sur les technologies emergentes du numerique (Ministry of Digital Transition) held a national validation workshop on the 2026-2030 national AI roadmap, whose drafting the source says mobilised the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and the diaspora as well as officials and donors; the source does not name outside attendees in the room.
facts.system: Feuille de route nationale de l'intelligence artificielle 2026-2030
